rows.details: ICMR project titled "Moxifloxacin containing shorter regimen versus 6 months standard regimen for treatment of drug-sensitive TB disease in children aged 1 year to 18 years - open-label randomised controlled trial (4M kids' trial)"
Purely temporary, co-terminus with the project; half-yearly renewal after assessment

content_sections.heading: About Andhra Medical College Project Research Scientist (Medical)
content_sections.text: Andhra Medical College is a medical college in Visakhapatnam. This recruitment is run by its Department of Paediatrics for an ICMR project, the "4M kids' trial", an open-label randomised controlled trial comparing a Moxifloxacin-containing shorter regimen with the 6 months standard regimen for drug-sensitive TB disease in children aged 1 year to 18 years. The notice is signed by the Professor and HOD of Paediatrics, who is the Principal Investigator, and by the Principal of Andhra Medical College.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Medical degree (MBBS/MD). Must be registered with the state Medical Council. All educational qualification certificates must be from a recognised Board/university. Masters in PSM/Community Medicine. Previous experience in clinical research project or a randomized controlled trial (RCT)/Experience in field implementation of projects and involvement in primary community-based activities. Experience in handling electronic data capture and its related process. Knowledge of data management and statistical analysis. Knowledge of resource and team management. Experience will be counted from the date of completion of minimum educational qualification. All experience gained shall preferably be from a Govt. organisation. Experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the study of the project concerned, will be considered. The upper age limit is 45 years. The notice does not mention a minimum age, an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly salary: Rs: 67000 + 20% HRA. Since the project involves fieldwork, applicants should be willing to travel to the field; allowances will be provided, as admissible. No Provident Fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim or any other fringe benefits will be given, as the post is purely temporary. Employment is subject to half-yearly renewal after assessment and can be terminated after giving one-month prior notice on either side. Leave will be as per the rules and regulations permitted by Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam for contractual positions. The fixed term engagement, initial as well as extended, shall automatically cease if not extended within the tenure; no retrospective extension is permissible. There is no provision for Government accommodation inside or outside the campus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Andhra Medical College Project Research Scientist (Medical)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only. Send your bio-data and contact details to [email protected] so that it reaches by 2 December 2026, and clearly mention the post you are applying for (Project Research Scientist (Medical)). Self-attested e-copies of these certificates must be attached: 10th class certificate Relevant degree certificates Registration certificate with the concerned council Relevant experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. The interview date will be communicated later via email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, and mere participation in the interview does not guarantee selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Andhra Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist (Medical) in the Department of Paediatrics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send the bio-data with relevant documents by email is 2 December 2026. Late applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Project Research Scientist (Medical) post?
faq.answer: A medical degree (MBBS/MD) with registration with the state Medical Council is essential. A Masters in PSM/Community Medicine and research or RCT experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Research Scientist (Medical)?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 67,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% HRA is paid on top of Rs. 67,000, and allowances for fieldwork will be provided as admissible. Provident Fund, LTC, Medical Claim and other fringe benefits are not given.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your bio-data and contact details, with self-attested e-copies of your 10th certificate, degree certificates, council registration and experience certificates, to [email protected], and clearly mention the post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview, whose date will be communicated later via email. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Project Research Scientist (Medical) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the ICMR project, subject to half-yearly renewal after assessment, with no claim to permanent employment.
